description:
Analysis code and the saved outputs of every run reported in the manuscript "Trust Without Detectable Decision Gains: Explained At-Risk Predictions, Educator Decisions, and the Limits of Model Portability".

README.md at the repository root gives a run order mapping each script to the section it produces. Code/acceptance_gate.py re-derives 86 reported figures from the committed outputs and exits non-zero on any failure or unverified claim; the log for this release is outputs/acceptance_gate_log.txt and ends "Safe to tag". Code/G8_FIX_02_verify_oulad.py independently re-derives every OULAD figure from four committed artefacts alone, without the notebook, the model or the raw data.

Not included: the institutional student records, which cannot be shared and remain the property of the university; three individual-level outputs carrying one row per student with outcome and fee-payment status; raw educator responses, withheld in line with the consent given, though the scored aggregate outcomes they support are included; and trained model weights, held by the data custodian.

Produced with Python 3.13.18, XGBoost 3.4.1, scikit-learn 1.6.1 and imbalanced-learn 0.14.2. Code/requirements.lock.txt is the full pinned environment.

The OULAD dataset is publicly available under CC BY 4.0 (Kuzilek, Hlosta and Zdrahal, 2017); the oulad_* outputs are derived from it.
